message.text: The S3 presign runner prevents external attachment links from going stale. I am now reading its implementation and the server startup wiring to identify the exact schedule and line numbers.

Checking where `startBackgroundRunners` is called to confirm its wiring into server startup.

The S3 presign runner refreshes external attachment links every 12 hours. It is wired into server startup in `server/server.go` around lines 153–171 inside `startBackgroundRunners`.

The S3 presign runner (`s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign`) refreshes external attachment links every 12 hours.

It is wired into server startup at `server/server.go:129` inside `Server.Start`, which calls `s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)`. The runner itself is created at lines 161–171.

h01.
s3presign.Runner — every 12 hours — server/server.go:129

The `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` re-presigns S3 attachment URLs so stored references stay valid (presigned URLs expire after 5 days; it refreshes ones that would lapse within 4 days). `runnerInterval` is `12 * time.Hour`. `Server.Start` hooks it in via `s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)` at `server/server.go:129`, which constructs the runner, runs it once, then starts `Run` on a 12-hour ticker.
